## Properties

<a id="keepuncalculated"></a>
### KeepUncalculated

```csharp
public bool KeepUncalculated { get; init; }
```

What to do with formulas SharpCell cannot calculate, such as calls of functions it does not know or links to other workbooks. False (the default) refuses to save with an [XlsxWriteException](SharpCell.Xlsx.XlsxWriteException.md). True keeps the result Excel saved for them and marks the file so that Excel recalculates every formula when it opens it; until then, cells that read such a formula show what SharpCell calculated for them.
